smell_elimination.justification: The feature envy smell is almost completely eliminated. The refactoring moves all state manipulation logic from CalibratedClassifierCV into _CalibratedClassifier through the new post_fit_processing() method. The only minor trace is that _sync_calibrated_attributes still exists, but it now properly delegates rather than manipulating foreign data.

cross_file_coordination.justification: All changes are properly coordinated within the single file. The refactoring introduces three new methods in _CalibratedClassifier (post_fit_processing, get_n_features_in, get_feature_names_in) and updates _sync_calibrated_attributes to use them. No orphaned code, unused imports, or dangling references remain.

structural_soundness.justification: Excellent decomposition with clear separation of responsibilities. _CalibratedClassifier now owns its post-fit processing logic and provides clean getter methods for feature metadata. The _sync_calibrated_attributes method is simplified to its legitimate concern (syncing features from calibrated classifiers). Minor point: the method name 'post_fit_processing' is slightly generic but acceptable.

code_quality.justification: Clean, readable code with well-named methods. The getter methods (get_n_features_in, get_feature_names_in) follow clear naming conventions. The post_fit_processing method encapsulates all the calibrator configuration logic in one place. Code is idiomatic and maintainable with proper null checks.

method_placement.justification: Perfect placement. All logic that manipulates _CalibratedClassifier and calibrator state has been moved into _CalibratedClassifier itself. The post_fit_processing method is exactly where this logic belongs - in the class that owns the data being manipulated.

data_locality_and_delegation.justification: Excellent data locality. The post_fit_processing method operates entirely on local data (self.calibrators, self.estimator, self.classes). The delegation pattern in _sync_calibrated_attributes is clean and justified - it calls high-level methods (get_n_features_in, get_feature_names_in, post_fit_processing) rather than accessing internal state directly.

responsibility_relocation_to__calibrated.justification: Complete relocation of responsibility. All calibrator configuration (out_of_bounds, fitted_ flag) and _pos_class_indices computation now happens within _CalibratedClassifier.post_fit_processing(). CalibratedClassifierCV no longer accesses .calibrators, .method, or sets attributes directly. It simply calls post_fit_processing() on each calibrated classifier.

encapsulation_and_law_of_demeter_complia.justification: Complete elimination of Law of Demeter violations. No more cal_clf.calibrators[i].attribute access. All interactions go through _CalibratedClassifier's public interface (post_fit_processing, get_n_features_in, get_feature_names_in). Clear encapsulation boundaries are fully restored between the two classes.

aspect_3_judge.summary: This is an exemplary refactoring that thoroughly eliminates the feature envy smell. All state manipulation logic has been properly relocated to _CalibratedClassifier, Law of Demeter violations are completely removed, and clean getter methods provide proper encapsulation. The refactoring transforms CalibratedClassifierCV from manipulating internal structures to calling high-level methods, restoring clear class boundaries and single responsibility.
